name: SkyLedger
tagline: Satellites see the leaks. Companies report the numbers. An agent team checks one against the other.
sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=true (default) runs with no credentials, no network and no GPU
traces: logs/trace-<run_id>.jsonl, hash-chained, also printed to stdout

zetaris.what: Federated geo-join of Carbon Mapper sources x GHGRP facilities x GHGRP CH4 totals, queried in place over the Zetaris REST SQL API; source discovery and row counts
zetaris.verified: 2026-10-26: three Lightning filestore tables registered (scripts/zetaris_register.ts); live geo-join identical to the cache for 60/60 plumes (scripts/check_zetaris_parity.ts)

nightshift.what: Primary AI provider per the Power-prompt contract (headers, /v1/models discovery, rt-local rejection, 180 s timeout, Auto Detect)
nightshift.verified: 2026-10-26: Nightshift 1.2.7 on Windows; scripts/check_meterless.ts passes the provider done-criteria

world_model.what: Facility -> owner -> parent entity graph with provenance on every write, alias merging of messy owner strings, operator review queue, audit log

scout_intent.what: Analyst sign-off issues an ExecutionContract in the Scout Intent shape, HMAC-SHA256 over canonical JSON, with an operator-review approval record

nvidia.what: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B A3B through Meterless Nightshift writes each dossier (number guard). Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B A12B reads each plume image blind and is checked against the wind; a disagreement triggers a Skeptic re-read.
nvidia.disclosure: Nightshift 1.2.7 refuses image requests to Nemotron VL models (docs/METERLESS_VISION_ISSUE.md). PlumeReader tries Nightshift first and falls back to NVIDIA API direct for the image step only; every fallback is logged.

data_sources: Carbon Mapper CH4 sources and plumes
US EPA GHGRP (Envirofacts) facilities and CH4 by subpart, RY2023
